privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your files never leave your computer
privacy.subtitleDesc: ConvertKit operates entirely in your browser. Your images and videos stay in your device memory from start to finish — they never even reach a neighboring folder, let alone a server.
privacy.whyNotUpload: Why no uploads? Having a conscience?
privacy.whyNotUploadDesc: Not exactly. The main reason is — I'm broke. Servers cost money, bandwidth costs money, storage costs money. I don't even have a proper server, where would I upload to?
privacy.whyNotUploadDesc2: But here's the silver lining: being broke means your privacy is perfectly protected. No server, no leaks. This is what they call 'poverty breeds virtue' 😭.
technicalItems: Everything runs in browser sandbox — safer than your front door lock
Image data exists only in browser memory — gone when you close the tab
Zero network requests — try using it offline, it works
No cookies, no tracking, no ads — cleaner than a freshly formatted hard drive
privacy.whatDataDesc: Absolutely nothing. No registration, no login, no email, no phone number. You come here, process some images, and walk away — I know nothing. Even if the FBI asked, I'd just shrug and say 'no idea'.
privacy.summary: TL;DR: You're safe because the developer is broke
privacy.summaryDesc: Just use it. Relax. Your images are safer here than on your own hard drive — at least someone could touch your hard drive, while my server literally doesn't exist.
